description: A breakdown of a whole: the total, a proportional strip and a table of the parts, biggest first. The rounded shares come from a largest-remainder split, so they add up to exactly 100 % (or to the parts' share of a bigger declared total, with an explicit "Other" row for the rest). The strip is decorative (aria-hidden) and the table is the accessible presentation, so nothing is announced twice. A period switcher is opt-in through PeriodOptions + Period, and a re-sorted order animates with a CSS-only FLIP transition that prefers-reduced-motion suppresses.

parameters.name: Parts
parameters.description: The parts of the whole. The rows render biggest first (a stable sort, so equal values keep the host's order); a negative value counts as zero for the share while the row itself stays visible.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: An optional heading above the card. It also NAMES the table (as its caption), so a reader hears what the numbers are a breakdown of.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: The accessible name used when no Title is rendered. Null means the localized default ("Breakdown").

parameters.name: Total
parameters.description: The declared whole the parts are a share of. Null (the default) means the parts' sum, which makes the rounded shares add up to exactly 100 %. A declared total bigger than the sum adds an explicit localized "Other" row and segment for the rest; a total below the sum cannot be the whole, so it is ignored and the sum is used — a breakdown never renders a share above 100 %.

parameters.name: ValueFormat
parameters.description: The .NET numeric format string of every value (parts and the total). The share column is always a whole, culture-formatted percentage.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats the values and the shares. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time.

parameters.name: ShowTotal
parameters.description: Renders the total row above the strip.

parameters.name: ShowBar
parameters.description: Renders the proportional strip. It is aria-hidden in every case: the table carries the data.

parameters.name: AnimateReorder
parameters.description: Animates the rows into their new places when the sorted order changes (a FLIP: the component computes each moved row's shift, the row carries it as --tm-breakdown-card-row-shift and one keyframe animation slides it home — single render, no JavaScript). A row that did not move never animates, and a second reorder restarts the animation. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce clamps it to 0.01 ms regardless of this switch, and the table's order never depends on the animation.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Renders the loading placeholder: skeletons plus a visually hidden localized "Loading breakdown" text, with aria-busy="true" on the root.

parameters.name: PeriodOptions
parameters.description: The periods a host can switch between, rendered as a single-choice segmented control when at least one option is supplied. The card does not interpret the values — it raises PeriodChanged and the host loads the matching data.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The currently selected period (one of the PeriodOptions values), two-way bound with PeriodChanged.

parameters.name: PeriodChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the newly selected period value. Bind it with @bind-Period.

parameters.name: PeriodLabel
parameters.description: The label above the period switcher. Null means the localized default ("Period") — the switcher is always named for a reader.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: DataTestId
parameters.description: Overrides the root data-testid; the default id is breakdown-card and TestIdPrefix namespaces it.

parameters.name: TestIdPrefix
parameters.description: Namespaces every internal data-testid of this instance as "{prefix}-{name}", so several cards on one page stay targetable.

examples.code:
<TmBreakdownCard Parts="@parts"
                 PeriodOptions="@periods"
                 @bind-Period="period" />
@code {
    private string period = "month";
    private readonly SelectOption<string>[] periods =
    [
        new("month", "This month"),
        new("week", "Last week")
    ];
}
